svg.text: Gray = receptor chain A, colored = ligand chain B. No official native PDB was found locally/remotely, so the high-quality TraDock top1 is shown as native-like reference.
min CA-chain distance=5.0 A CA contacts<8A=38
min CA-chain distance=4.1 A CA contacts<8A=101
Why success: TraDock top1 has fnat=0.925, meaning it recovers 92.5% of native contacts, above the fnat>0.3 threshold.
DockQ=0.9026 and low RMSD indicate a near-native pose. Original top1 has fnat=0 and very large RMSD.
